supersedes: the 2026-09-06T05:45:00Z revision — 20 retire + 40 reslug onto the HOST product's key, with the 20 base rows deliberately omitted. MEASURED AGAIN read-only for this PR: the 40 `sub-`-segment ids it named NO LONGER EXIST (the fold lanes consolidated them since), and the product now holds exactly 60 clean BBP rows, three rungs per card, no `sub-` anywhere. Drew's ruling then moves the destination off the host key entirely, so all 60 move.
rulings: CF-BOWMANS-BEST-PREVIEW-IS-ITS-OWN-PRODUCT (Drew, 2026-09-06): the 20-card BBP1-BBP20 insert is its own product key `bowmans-best-preview`, in BOTH sports it was packed out in.

ONE KEY FOR BOTH SPORTS. The sport segment already separates the basketball roster (BBP1 Allen Iverson ... BBP20 Tariq Abdul-Wahad) from the baseball one (BBP1 Frank Thomas ... BBP4 Derek Jeter). Two keys for one insert would be the split this ruling closes.

THE ALIAS ROWS AND THE `sub-` ROWS ARE ALREADY GONE. The prior revision's whole retire half existed to vacate addresses for its reslug half; measured today, the product holds 60 rows and not one carries a `sub-` segment or duplicates a rung. So this revision has NO retire entries — there is nothing left to retire, and naming ids that do not exist would be a list that reports success while doing nothing.

ALL 60 MOVE, INCLUDING THE 20 BASE ROWS. The prior revision omitted the base rows because they were correct while the Preview lived on the host's key. Under the ruled key, leaving them behind would ship two rungs of a card on one product and the third on another — the split pool in its purest form.

THE RUNG IS PRESERVED EXACTLY. `base` / `refractor` / `atomic-refractor`, 20 of each, read from each row's own stored parallel. Atomic Refractor is its own rung (parallelLadders.ts, /100) and never folds into the plain one.
EVERY TARGET IS VACANT. `bowmans-best-preview` holds ZERO catalog rows today. The lane refuses rather than merges on an occupied address, which is the check that catches a re-run after a re-mint.
THE 363 OTHER 1997 topps-stadium-club rows are the legitimate Stadium Club checklist (Michael Jordan #118 among them) and are NOT in scope.
THE FOOTBALL EDITION of this same insert (Bledsoe #BBP15) is a different checklist and is excluded, unchanged from the prior revision.
